home.title: SpotiGrab
home.subtitle: Paste a Spotify playlist link and automatically find matching tracks on YouTube to download locally. No more manual searching, one by one.
home.footer: For personal backup use only. Please respect music creators' copyrights and support official music platforms.
home.heroDescription: Paste a Spotify playlist and we'll find matching sources, organize tracks, and pack them into a convenient ZIP file.
home.step1Desc: Enter a public Spotify playlist URL
home.step2Desc: Check match results and select the songs you need
home.step3Desc: Get a neatly organized ZIP file when done

pricing.metaDescription: SpotiGrab offers a free plan, monthly/quarterly/yearly subscriptions, and pay-per-track downloads. Pick the plan that fits you.
pricing.title: Pick the plan that fits you
pricing.description: The free plan covers 3 downloads per day. Subscribe for unlimited downloads and high-quality MP3, or pay per track if you only need a few songs.
pricing.subscriptionsDescription: Every subscription includes the same features — longer terms simply cost less per month.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: Enough for backing up a few songs now and then

monthly.name: Monthly
monthly.tagline: A great starting point, cancel anytime

quarterly.name: Quarterly
quarterly.tagline: Three months of unlimited downloads, best value

yearly.name: Yearly
yearly.tagline: The best option for long-term listeners

payPerTrack.name: Pay per track
payPerTrack.tagline: Pay only for the songs you download, no subscription

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. No subscription is locked in, and you keep access until the end of the current term.
faq.a2: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades take effect once the current term ends.
faq.a3: Credit card, ATM transfer, and convenience-store code or barcode, handled by ECPay.
faq.q4: What audio quality do I get?
faq.a4: Paid plans deliver 320kbps MP3, while the free plan uses 128kbps standard quality.
faq.q5: What are the free plan limits?
faq.a5: Up to 3 downloads per day, with no signup required.
faq.q6: Do subscribers still pay per track?
faq.a6: No. Subscriptions include unlimited downloads with no extra charges.
